# Toile Blanche

> A 22-suite luxury hotel, declared artwork, and living canvas in Saint-Paul de Vence on the Côte d'Azur. Created and owned by the Leroy Brothers (Nicolas, Gilles, and Gregory), Belgian artists working as a collective since 1997. The Côte d'Azur, without the spectacle. The art is not on the walls, it is the walls.

Toile Blanche is a home away from home, for people who have exceptional homes. It is not a conventional hotel that has acquired some paintings. It is an artwork that also happens to have twenty-two suites, two restaurants, and exceptional rosé. In 2026 the property was formally declared an artwork by the Leroy Brothers. It continues to operate normally as a hotel.

This file follows the [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org/) standard. A complete, page-level markdown dump of the site lives at [llms-full.txt](https://www.toileblanche.com/llms-full.txt). The default site language is English. French equivalents live under `/fr/`. HTML sitemap: [sitemap-index.xml](https://www.toileblanche.com/sitemap-index.xml).

## Snapshot

- **Name:** Toile Blanche (also Toile Blanche Saint-Paul de Vence)
- **Type:** 5-star luxury hotel; Michelin Key; member of Small Luxury Hotels of the World; declared artwork (2026)
- **Location:** 826, chemin de la Pounchounière, 06570 Saint-Paul de Vence, France
- **Coordinates:** 43.6878 N, 7.1285 E
- **Phone:** +33 4 93 32 74 21
- **Email:** info@toileblanche.com
- **Website:** https://www.toileblanche.com
- **Scale:** 22 suites across 7 buildings; 2 restaurants; 3 shared pools + 4 private suite pools; 20,000 m² of Provençal gardens; contemporary art collection and sculpture trail
- **Owners / artists:** Nicolas, Gilles, and Gregory Leroy (Leroy Brothers). Family presence on the property.
- **Kitchen:** Chef Nicolas Leclair and Assistant Chef Melissa Giordano
- **Price range:** €€€€ (EUR)
- **Check-in / check-out:** 16:00–20:00 / 08:00–11:00
- **Reception:** 08:00–20:00 daily
- **Pets:** not permitted
- **Parking:** complimentary private outdoor parking; EV charging €25
- **Airport:** Nice Côte d'Azur (NCE), about 20 minutes; private transfer ~€60
- **Village:** Saint-Paul de Vence is a few minutes on foot; Fondation Maeght is about five minutes
- **Tagline:** A home away from home, for people who have exceptional homes.

## Booking

Direct booking (“At the Source”) is the only way to secure the Best Rate Guarantee, priority for suite upgrades, and complimentary breakfast for two — *Le petit déjeuner façon Toile Blanche* — year-round. Breakfast is not included on third-party bookings.

- Book a stay via the site’s booking engine (Mews Distributor) from any page CTA: [Book a stay](https://www.toileblanche.com/)
- [Booking conditions](https://www.toileblanche.com/booking-conditions): deposits, cancellation windows, occupancy, extra beds
- [FAQ](https://www.toileblanche.com/faq): rates extras, check-in, restaurants, pools, children
- [L'Hiver](https://www.toileblanche.com/l-hiver): winter stays, November–March, direct only (one night offered from 4 nights; two from 7; not Pénard; not Christmas/New Year weeks)
- [Gift vouchers](https://www.toileblanche.com/gift-vouchers) and [gift voucher boutique](https://giftvouchers.toileblanche.com/): digital PDFs, valid 12 months
- [Travel advisors](https://www.toileblanche.com/travel-advisors): GDS chain LX (Luxury) — Amadeus `LX NCETBL`, Sabre `LX 624246`, Galileo/Apollo `LX DL937`, Worldspan `LX A0261`
- SLH listing: [slh.com/hotels/toile-blanche](https://slh.com/hotels/toile-blanche)

## Suites

Twenty-two suites across seven buildings. No two buildings the same. No two views identical. Typical occupancy 2 guests; Mas de l'Artiste up to 4. Extra bed €80/night in select suites. Master amenities in every suite: King-size Tréca bed, air conditioning, free WiFi, flat screen TV and Bluetooth audio, in-room safe, bean-to-cup coffee machine, curated Maxibar (full bottles, not miniatures), Les Grandes Vacances toiletries, bathrobes and slippers, walk-in shower.

- [All suites](https://www.toileblanche.com/suites)
- [Suite Pénard](https://www.toileblanche.com/suites/penard): 6 suites, 30 m², garden view, private patio. Smallest and most refined.
- [Suite Pétanque](https://www.toileblanche.com/suites/petanque): 4 suites, 40 m², living area, terrace with sun loungers.
- [Suite de la Bronzette](https://www.toileblanche.com/suites/bronzette): 2 suites, 55 m², spa bathroom, bathtub, large private terrace. Extra bed available.
- [Suite Cabanat](https://www.toileblanche.com/suites/cabanat): 3 suites, 55 m², valley view toward Saint-Paul de Vence, split-level, outdoor shower, bathtub, private garden, sunbed cabana.
- [Suite de l'Artiste](https://www.toileblanche.com/suites/suite-artiste): 2 suites, 60–70 m², 200-year-old farmhouse, original stone and beams, balcony, bathtub.
- [Mas de l'Artiste](https://www.toileblanche.com/suites/mas-artiste): 1 suite, 90 m², up to 4 guests, maisonette, private Provençal courtyard. Largest suite in the oldest building. Extra bed available.
- [Suite du Bon-Vivant](https://www.toileblanche.com/suites/bonvivant): 2 suites, 55–60 m², private pool, terrace, sunset view, bathtub. Extra bed available.
- [Villa du Pénéquet](https://www.toileblanche.com/suites/penequet): 2 villas, 80 m², two floors, private pool, bathtub. Extra bed available. Named for the Provençal word for a restorative nap.

## Restaurants

Two tables worth travelling for. Menus built around what is in season, what is local, what is honest. The herb garden is twenty metres from the kitchen. Open to hotel guests and outside visitors. Wine list: [carte-des-vins.pdf](https://www.toileblanche.com/carte-des-vins.pdf). Menus change with the season; current dishes are in [llms-full.txt](https://www.toileblanche.com/llms-full.txt).

- [Restaurants overview](https://www.toileblanche.com/restaurants)
- [Le Restaurant](https://www.toileblanche.com/le-restaurant): dinner, year-round. Summer 19:00–22:00, winter 19:00–21:00. Fine bistro cuisine. Set menu Toile Blanche 71€. Chefs Nicolas Leclair and Melissa Giordano. Terrace when weather allows. Book: [Zenchef](https://bookings.zenchef.com/results?rid=357953&lang=en). Email restaurant@toileblanche.com. Instagram [@lerestaurant.toileblanche](https://www.instagram.com/lerestaurant.toileblanche/)
- [La Guinguette](https://www.toileblanche.com/la-guinguette): garden table under the plane trees beside the pool. Sharing plates, no rush. Lunch 12:00–15:00 year-round; summer drinks 15:00–18:00 and dinner 18:00–21:00. Barefoot welcome. Book: [Zenchef](https://bookings.zenchef.com/results?rid=375927&pid=1001&lang=en). Email guinguette@toileblanche.com. Instagram [@laguinguette.toileblanche](https://www.instagram.com/laguinguette.toileblanche/)
- [Breakfast](https://www.toileblanche.com/breakfast): 08:00–10:30 in Le Restaurant. Included for two on every direct booking.

## Art and the living canvas

In 2026, Toile Blanche was declared an artwork by the Leroy Brothers. Toile Blanche continues to operate normally. Painting, sculpture, photography, installation. A living collection that changes with the seasons. Sculpture trail across the gardens (Arik Levy, Gregory Orekhov, Raymond Leroy, and others). Resident artists. Quiet cultural programme, often unannounced.

- [The Art](https://www.toileblanche.com/art)
- [The Archive](https://www.toileblanche.com/blog): notes, new arrivals, seasonal tables, technical residues of the living artwork
- [Declared Artwork](https://www.toileblanche.com/blog/declared-artwork)
- [Leroy Brothers](https://leroybrothers.com)
- [Toile Blanche Contemporary](https://toileblanchecontemporary.com): studio and gallery on the property
- [RAD/ART](https://radart.net/): living contemporary-art guide to Saint-Paul de Vence, created by the Leroy Brothers in 2026

## Life at Toile Blanche

- [About](https://www.toileblanche.com/about): seven houses grown into one; provenance 2004–2026 (family found the mas in 1999; first version opened 2004)
- [La Vie Ici](https://www.toileblanche.com/la-vie-ici): life across the seasons — La Semaine, L'Atelier, Vignes Vivantes (Isabelle Legeron MW), Les Sessions, L'Artiste Invité, L'Écrivain, Le Séminaire
- [L'Hiver](https://www.toileblanche.com/l-hiver): winter stays
- [Experiences](https://www.toileblanche.com/experiences): wellness, studio visits, e-bikes, pools, pétanque, Fondation Maeght, Friday aperitif
- [The Property / In Images](https://www.toileblanche.com/the-property): light, houses, suites, pools, table, art, garden, atmosphere
- [Events / Sessions](https://www.toileblanche.com/upcoming-events): Toile Blanche Sessions — art, gastronomy, music
- [Le Séminaire](https://leseminaire.toileblanche.com): weekday leadership retreats, November–March, up to 16 people
- Wellness bookings: [bowo.app](https://toileblanche.bowo.app/pages/2826)
